about: Custom types P1: a wolf (harness_type_a, like goblin, own hobgoblin walk art) walks out of the nest door with its own sprites and no tint, is called through the doors into a mod cell that lists only it, by name (cell A), draws there with the cell's mon_spr_wolf set (cell A) or the plain mon_spr set (cell B), and is still in the cell after save/reload, with the out-of-nest count equal to the live wolves.
